exceptionMessage: [TABLE_OR_VIEW_NOT_FOUND] The table or view `spark_catalog`.`ashlar_g03_b1d3d387fb77`.`object_current` cannot be found. Verify the spelling and correctness of the schema and catalog.
executionPoint: Spark read the retained manifest snapshot, created the four aliases in runnerCreatedNamespace, and every DESCRIBE DETAIL UUID/location check passed for those alias names. The compiled grouped request uses compilerNames in weftBindingNamespace. Analysis then reported the compiler-named object_current relation unresolved inside RelationTimeTravel. Cleanup dropped all four aliases and their database, stopped Spark and released all three locks. The failed grouped query performed no data scan and no Delta log head changed.
finding: Concrete adapter namespace mismatch, not an established Weft compiler or Delta time-travel defect. The Weft binding derives database suffix b1d3d387fb77 from publicationId. The r8 runner derived suffix 38b126893d31 from installationId. Thus DESCRIBE DETAIL validated aliases in a different database than the SQL referenced. The SQL itself retains Delta’s documented `FROM table_name VERSION AS OF version` form (https://docs.delta.io/delta-batch/). The minimal fix is to create aliases in the publication-derived namespace already present in the binding; do not rewrite compiler SQL. R9 is prepared with that adapter fix and the compiled request/response artifact hashes are byte-identical to r8. No native retry is made before Sol review.
